chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim asked him about a man who carries his wife or touches her, and then ejaculates or emits pre-seminal fluid, so he said:

"If he carries her or touches her with desire, then whether he ejaculates, does not ejaculate, emits pre-seminal fluid, or does not emit pre-seminal fluid, a sheep's blood is upon him, which he must spill. And if he carries her or touches her without desire, then there is nothing upon him, whether he ejaculates, does not ejaculate, emits pre-seminal fluid, or does not emit pre-seminal fluid."

key_terms.دَمُ شَاةٍ: the sacrifice of a sheep as expiation
key_terms.فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ: there is no liability or penalty upon him
key_terms.يُهَرِيقُهُ: he must spill it, meaning offer it sacrificially

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a pilgrim in ihram who touches or carries his wife with desire?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a muhrim who carries or touches his wife during hajj or 'umrah. If the contact is with shahwah (lust), a sheep must be sacrificed regardless of whether semen or pre-seminal fluid is emitted; if it is without lust, no penalty is due.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2591 - Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who carries his wife or touches her, and as a result, ejaculates or emits pre-seminal fluid.
Imam (as) said: "

If he carries or touches her with lust, whether he ejaculates, does not ejaculate, emits pre-seminal fluid, or does not emit pre-seminal fluid, he must offer a sheep as a sacrifice. If he carries or touches her without lust, then there is nothing upon him, whether he ejaculates, does not ejaculate, emits pre-seminal fluid, or does not emit pre-seminal fluid."
